milestones.title: CI diagnosis and repair
milestones.summary: The owner accepted the bounded Phase 3 proof on 15 October 2026. Hosted results include a verified narrow repair published as an exact draft PR, an owner-performed merge, and an infrastructure diagnosis without source changes. The uncertain-report outcome was accepted.
limitations: Successful intermittent-failure classification remains unqualified. The comparison retained Unknown because execution conditions differed.
The proof used owner-started workflows, one controlled application profile, and a deterministic repair. It does not qualify live-model or general autonomous remediation.
Retained-state replay checks were local. No new SDK verification of the merged product commit or deployment is claimed.

milestones.title: Alert investigation and approvals
milestones.summary: The owner accepted the bounded synthetic Phase 4 PoC on 18 October 2026. Hosted investigation, two native owner approvals, protected original reproduction and a verified one-line repair reached exact draft publication. The owner separately approved and merged the repair.
limitations: One publication-accounting invocation missed its approved deadline. Acceptance carries this operational exception without retroactively authorizing the violation.
Synthetic input, deterministic repair and owner-started stages do not qualify production monitoring, general autonomous repair or live-model use.
Full live negative and active-cancellation coverage remains unqualified despite passing local tests.
Current comment reads do not eliminate API check-to-write races. Unavailability does not prove deletion or grant approval.
Reserved accounting allowances remain explicit in private evidence; actual billed usage is unknown.
No deployment, production remediation or next-phase authority is claimed.

milestones.title: Same-runtime Factory evaluation
milestones.summary: Technical feasibility was demonstrated within the tested scope. Comparative benefit over Baseline was not demonstrated. Further paid Phase 5A execution has stopped. The evaluation remains incomplete: 18 of 20 original attempts were consumed; both A1 attempts remain blocked and unexecuted.
limitations: Fifteen original attempts have linked CORRECT outcomes. Two C2 attempts were collection rejections; one I2 Factory attempt produced INVALID_OUTPUT.
The six completed flat-json-v2 pairs produced six CORRECT outcomes per treatment. Original v1 and flat-json-v2 groups remain separate; supplemental C2 pilots do not replace original outcomes.
Human scoring used owner self-review with fixture-author overlap. Independent human review is not claimed.
Original-cohort and treatment-specific actual billed costs and measured human engineering effort remain UNKNOWN. Comparative cost and human-effort thresholds are not established as PASS.
A1 review and implementation-approval requirements remain unmet. An approved scheduling exception allowed A2 and A3 to proceed while A1 stayed blocked.
The exploratory result does not establish full Phase 5A acceptance, production readiness, general autonomous remediation or proven productivity improvements.
